platformDescription: Configure the platform-level private R2 bucket used by agencies in Managed by LaraTik mode. Credentials are encrypted and never shown again.
ownedDescription: Connect a separate R2 account and bucket for this agency. LaraTik stores only encrypted credentials and uses them server-side.
ownedInstructions: Create an R2 API token with access limited to the selected bucket, then enter its S3-compatible credentials below. LaraTik will verify the pair before saving it.
ownedEndpointHint: Use the HTTPS S3 endpoint for your Cloudflare account, for example https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com.
ownedCredentialHint: Credentials are encrypted at rest, never returned to the browser, and never included in audit records.
ownedTestHint: The test performs a temporary write, read, and delete using this agency's exact credential and bucket pair.
backendChangeLocked: Existing media or active uploads are using the current storage backend. Complete a reviewed storage migration before changing the bucket or account.
ownedTestSuccess: The agency R2 connection test succeeded.
ownedSavedVerified: Agency-owned R2 is connected and verified.
managedSwitched: The agency is back on LaraTik-managed storage.
backendMigrationRequired: Storage cannot change while media or active uploads exist. Complete a reviewed storage migration first.
testHint: Runs a temporary write, read, and delete probe against the private bucket.
endpointHint: Use the S3-compatible HTTPS endpoint for your Cloudflare account.
credentialHint: Credentials are encrypted and never returned to the browser.
rotateHint: Enter new credentials to rotate the active pair.
secretsNote: Secrets are encrypted at rest. The form never displays saved credentials.
platformScopeDescription: Agencies using Managed by LaraTik store objects in this provider under an isolated agency prefix. An agency can use its own Cloudflare R2 account from Agency Settings → Storage.
agencyDescription: Private managed R2 storage and LaraTik upload limits for this agency.
agencyOwnedDescription: This agency's private Cloudflare R2 storage and LaraTik upload limits.
setupDescription: Your agency uses a private managed bucket. Complete the checks below before uploading media.
ownedSetupDescription: Your agency uses its own private R2 bucket. Complete the checks below before uploading media.
setupPlatformDescription: A platform owner connects the private Cloudflare R2 bucket once for all agencies.
setupOwnedDescription: This agency's own Cloudflare credentials are used only for this agency's private storage.
setupAgencyDescription: Enable new uploads for this agency. Existing media stays available when uploads are disabled.
setupVerifyDescription: Run a safe connection probe before your team starts uploading and previewing media.
ownedNotConfigured: This agency has not connected its own R2 bucket yet.
ownedProviderUnavailable: This agency's R2 connection is unavailable. Check the endpoint, bucket, and token.
providerUnavailable: The managed storage provider is not ready. Ask a platform owner to check the R2 connection.
requestSetupSubject: Set up managed storage for my agency
requestSetupBody: Please connect the managed Cloudflare R2 storage for my agency so our team can upload and preview media.
healthCheckSuccess: Connection verified. Uploads and previews can use the managed bucket.
ownedHealthCheckSuccess: Connection verified. Uploads and previews can use this agency's R2 bucket.
healthCheckFailed: The connection check failed. Confirm the platform R2 setup, then try again.
permissionDenied: You do not have permission to manage this agency's storage.
quotaDescription: This is the hard limit for new media uploads, controlled by the agency plan and any platform-approved override.
quotaIncludesReserved: Includes active upload reservations. Cloudflare billing usage is separate from this LaraTik limit.
privacyDescription: R2 credentials stay server-side. Your team receives short-lived links for upload and preview only.
scopePrefixDescription: Every object is generated under this agency prefix; workspace and asset identifiers are added automatically.
accessPolicyDescription: The bucket is private and every read or write is checked against this agency and workspace.
forbiddenBody: Only agency admins can view storage and quota details.
warning: Storage usage has reached 80% of the quota.
urgent: Storage usage has reached 90% of the quota.
overLimit: Storage quota is full. New uploads are blocked.
disabled: Storage is disabled. Existing media remains available.
notConfigured: The platform storage provider has not been configured yet.
testFailed: The storage provider rejected the connection test.
invalidConfiguration: Check the endpoint, bucket, and credentials.
saveFailed: Storage configuration could not be saved.
billingDescription: Published Standard storage rates and monthly free allowances for the connected Cloudflare R2 account.
billingNote: These are Cloudflare account-level billing allowances, not LaraTik upload limits. Check Cloudflare for live account usage; LaraTik enforces the plan quota above.
